title: AnswerOverridden
description: A human correction to a query's answer. Never modifies the original Event (ADR-0001) — this is its own new record, referencing the original QueryAnswered Event by id, with no field that could target or overwrite the original's own fields.

original_event_id.description: The id of the QueryAnswered Event this corrects.

note.description: Optional human-written reason for the correction.
